rows.r119_author_treatment: We preserve the Econometrica goal and original economic model, report direct original cost and action bounds, and show where actual common-method information savings become complete-service savings. With the fixed left-minus-right arm ordering, the 56 contrasts comprise 32 strictly negative, 20 strictly positive, 2 exact-zero and 2 unresolved intervals. The two unresolved comparisons are quadratic versus the degree-two polynomial, one at each risk; the two exact zeros are ReLU versus the equivalent conventional hinge. It remains a two-date investment validation, with no newly calibrated welfare unit, compute price, workload population or enlarged application attached to it.
